results.name: CN3EffectiveAll
results.scope: For every N>=2^249, with P the positive primitive x^2+xy+6y^2 numerical values, N belongs to P+P if and only if529 does not divideN. At every admissible such target the ordered numerical value-pair count is at least N^(5/7)/15000000000.
